dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Yes, the gallant knight and the heroine who liberated Mondstadt. She grew up a slave, but rose up to overthrow the oppressive ruling aristocrats, securing freedom for all in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Legend has it that this is where she ascended to Celestia and became the goddess who protects Mondstadt for eternity.

dialogues.speaker: Dr. Edith
dialogues.text: Different legends offer varying accounts of her life, but for the most part they converge right here, at this place, where her story ends.
